title: Pineapple Square Pattern #S-742
author: J. & P. Coats / Clark's (vintage leaflet, via Free Vintage Crochet)
notes: Vintage thread motif for a tablecloth (First Motif, rnds 1-12). start: original 'Starting at center, ch 10. Join with sl st to form ring.' replaced by magic ring. Rounds were run together in one paragraph as '1st rnd: ... 2nd rnd: ...'; split onto 'Round N:' lines. Second-motif joining, edging and materials omitted. No stated counts. Stitches the pattern passes without saying 'skip' (e.g. the ch-sp before 'tr in next tr') are left implicit in the DSL. Stitch graph: round 11 reads badly (cost 36.5); check where its stitches go.
